                  "shattered armor plates"

                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "crit-resist icon",
                  "glowing core",
                  "blue guide sparks",
                  "crumbling pillars"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie's next punch bounces off the Golem's core with a dull thud.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:3",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "Artie must find a way to bypass the resistance or die.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Fizz discovers that the Golem has a 'Crit-Resist' buff, making Artie's main weapon useless.",

                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "crit-resist icon",
                  "glowing core",
                  "blue guide sparks",
                  "crumbling pillars"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Fizz's voice crackles in Artie's ear as the Golem readies another strike.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "floor tile cracks",
                  "physics glitch sparks",
                  "yawning pit",
                  "falling debris"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie dives between the Golem's legs, aiming for the floor tiles.",
                "type": "reveal"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
                "end_condition_echo": "The floor collapses, trapping the Golem in a hole.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:4",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "The floor collapses, trapping the Golem in a hole.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Artie attempts to 'Crit' the ground beneath the Golem, hoping for a physics glitch.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "floor tile cracks",
                  "physics glitch sparks",
                  "yawning pit",
                  "falling debris"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie's fist connects with a hairline fracture in the stone floor.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "glowing fist aura",
                  "heavy attack timer",
                  "trapped golem roar",
                  "dust clouds"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie stands at the edge of the pit, winding up his arm for the final blow.",
                "type": "choice"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "The Dance of Death"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.",
            "intent": "Resolve the boss fight with a comedic but effective exploit.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:3",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:5",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "Artie prepares his most powerful hit yet.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "While the Golem is stuck, Artie spends five minutes 'charging' a punch, which the System interprets as a 'Heavy Attack'.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "glowing fist aura",
                  "heavy attack timer",
                  "trapped golem roar",
                  "dust clouds"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie stands at the edge of the pit, winding up his arm.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "porcelain teacup pile",
                  "floral patterns",
                  "cosmetic crit glitter",
                  "system error chime"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie's fist connects with the Golem's skull with a high-pitched 'ding'.",
                "type": "setup"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:4",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:6",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "The boss is defeated, but the loot is... unconventional.",
                "scene_id": 5,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Artie lands the hit, but instead of damage, the System rolls a 'Cosmetic Crit,' turning the Golem into a pile of very expensive porcelain teacups.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "porcelain teacup pile",
                  "floral patterns",
                  "cosmetic crit glitter",
                  "system error chime"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The impact sends a shockwave of glitter through the chamber.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "golden level-up beam",
                  "rapid stat ticker",
                  "system recalculation bar",
                  "floating teacups"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "A massive 'LEVEL UP' banner fills Artie's vision.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "processed",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:5",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:7",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.",
                "scene_id": 6,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "The System panics and tries to 'recalculate' the XP, resulting in Artie jumping five levels instantly.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "golden level-up beam",
                  "rapid stat ticker",
                  "system recalculation bar",
                  "floating teacups"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The golden light of the level-up beam washes over Artie.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "silver ring band",
                  "gambler's mark",
                  "self-crit warning",
                  "porcelain shards"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie sifts through the pile of porcelain, looking for anything useful.",
                "type": "aftermath"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "The Final Blow"
          },

            "end_condition": "The chase is on as Artie heads toward the capital city.",
            "intent": "Examine the rewards and the consequences of the fight.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:6",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:8",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "Artie accepts the double-edged sword.",
                "scene_id": 7,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 20,
                "summary": "Artie finds a 'Ring of the Gambler' among the teacups, which doubles crit damage but makes every 20th hit a self-crit.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "silver ring band",
                  "gambler's mark",
                  "self-crit warning",
                  "porcelain shards"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie picks up a silver ring from the wreckage of the Golem.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "faded wall paint",
                  "gym teacher likeness",
                  "first glitch glyphs",
                  "hidden torch"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "A section of the wall slides back with a heavy grind.",
                "type": "reveal"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:7",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "3:9",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_SECRET_MURAL_ROOM_B35DBF",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_SECRET_MURAL_ROOM_B35DBF",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "outcome": "Artie realizes he isn't the first person to break this game.",
                "scene_id": 8,
                "summary": "A hidden door opens, revealing a mural of the 'First Glitch'\u2014a hero who looked suspiciously like Artie's high school gym teacher.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "faded wall paint",
                  "gym teacher likeness",
                  "first glitch glyphs",
                  "hidden torch"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie steps into the hidden room, his torch illuminating the mural.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "dusty mural",
                  "fading light",
                  "stone archway",
                  "echoing footsteps"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie turns away from the mural, heading back toward the main corridor.",
                "type": "reveal"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:8",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "3:10",
                "location_end": "Crypts - Upper Corridors",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_UPPER_CORRIDORS_D2F7E5",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Upper Corridors",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_SECRET_MURAL_ROOM_B35DBF",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Secret Mural Room",
                "outcome": "Artie retraces his steps to the surface.",
                "scene_id": 9,
                "summary": "Artie retraces his steps through the now-empty crypts, his new stats making the climb back to the surface trivially fast.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "dusty mural",
                  "fading light",
                  "stone archway",
                  "echoing footsteps"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Leaving the secret room behind, Artie jogs back through the empty halls.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "stone stairs",
                  "fresh air",
                  "crypt entrance",
                  "approaching voices"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "He bounds up the final flight of stone stairs, the smell of fresh air greeting him.",
                "type": "transition"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "pursued",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:9",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "3:11",
                "location_end": "Crypts Entrance",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_ENTRANCE_0B6508",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts Entrance",
                "location_start": "Crypts Entrance",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_ENTRANCE_0B6508",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts Entrance",
                "outcome": "Vane realizes Artie stole his kill.",
                "scene_id": 10,
                "summary": "Artie exits the crypt to find Vane waiting for him, looking very confused by the lack of a boss.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "stone stairs",
                  "fresh air",
                  "crypt entrance",
                  "approaching voices"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie emerges from the crypt into the cool evening air, only to freeze.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "white paladin cape",
                  "confused expression",
                  "drawn swords",
                  "sudden sprint"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vane's confusion turns to rage as Artie breaks into a sudden sprint.",
                "type": "escalation"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "fleeing",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:10",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:12",
                "location_end": "Crypts Outskirts",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_OUTSKIRTS_65ADF0",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts Outskirts",
                "location_start": "Crypts Entrance",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_ENTRANCE_0B6508",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts Entrance",
                "outcome": "Artie dodges the initial pursuit.",
                "scene_id": 11,
                "summary": "Vane's party launches a volley of spells and arrows, but Artie's absurdly high evasion and speed allow him to weave through the attacks as he breaks for the tree line.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY",
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "white paladin cape",
                  "confused expression",
                  "drawn swords",
                  "sudden sprint"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Arrows and low-level fireballs streak through the air as Artie bolts for the trees.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "whizzing arrows",
                  "scorched earth",
                  "tree line",
                  "open road"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "He clears the tree line, leaving the frustrated shouts of Vane's party behind him.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "fleeing",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:11",
                "end_condition_echo": "The chase is on as Artie heads toward the capital city.",
                "handoff_mode": "terminal",
                "location_end": "The Road to the Capital",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_THE_ROAD_TO_THE_CAPITAL_E19EF1",
                "location_end_label": "The Road to the Capital",
                "location_start": "The Road to the Capital",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_THE_ROAD_TO_THE_CAPITAL_E19EF1",
                "location_start_label": "The Road to the Capital",
                "outcome": "The chase is on.",
                "scene_id": 12,
                "summary": "Artie uses his new level-up speed to outrun Vane's party, heading toward the capital city.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "whizzing arrows",
                  "scorched earth",
                  "tree line",
                  "open road"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie's boots kick up dust as he hits the main road, racing toward the horizon.",
                "type": "transition"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "Looting the Teacups"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "If Artie wins, he becomes the first Level 10 'Anomaly'; if he loses, it's Game Over.",
        "title": "Math-Boss vs. The Glitch"
      }
    ]
  },
  "phase_report": {
    "touched_scene_refs": [
      "3:10",
      "3:12"
    ],
    "notes": [
      "Updated handoff_mode for scene 3:10 to arrival_checkpoint due to location jump.",
      "Updated handoff_mode for scene 3:12 to terminal as it is the final scene of the chapter."
    ]
  }
}
